experiment: Deterministic Latent World Model v3: Autonomous Multi-Step Latent Consistency

generation_config.input_convention: pre-command obs7 + previous executed normalized action4

dataset.transition_rule: o_t=inputs[t,:7], a_t=actions[t], next=inputs[t+1,:7]; within episode only
dataset.previous_action_rule: inputs[t,7:11] = executed normalized action at t-1; reset=0

initialization.conversion: one-time affine folding into T/D weights; no runtime latent normalization

initial_function_equivalence.probe_rule: fixed linspace rawz[-1,1] 8x64 and normalized action[-1,1] 8x4; no Test selection

initial_latent_scale.rule: initial Encoder real-history population std; fixed throughout training, difference loss has no mean subtraction

architecture.transition:
ResidualTransition(
  (head): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=68, out_features=128, bias=True)
    (1): Tanh()
    (2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=True)
    (3): Tanh()
    (4): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=64, bias=True)
  )
)
architecture.decoder:
ObservationDecoder(
  (head): Sequential(
    (0): Linear(in_features=64, out_features=128, bias=True)
    (1): Tanh()
    (2): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=128, bias=True)
    (3): Tanh()
    (4): Linear(in_features=128, out_features=7, bias=True)
  )
)

comparison.latent_comparison_limit: Each model uses its own post-training Train coordinates; raw latent errors, norms and decoder ratios are not cross-model physical invariants.

objective: Lobs=mean k0..10 observation-std MSE; Lauto=mean k1..10 fixed initial Train latent-std MSE(z_pred_autonomous-stopgrad(E(real future history))); Ltotal=Lobs+0.1Lauto; no local term
loss_field_mapping: history.consistency denotes ONLY autonomous multi-step consistency; weighted_consistency=0.1*consistency
stop_gradient: All future real-history reference targets detached/no-grad; source prefix E and all composed T states keep gradients; D absent from direct consistency graph
protocol: Original v1 autonomous prediction path reused unmodified; real-history reference ONLY loss target, absent at inference. Complete K10 BPTT, no corrections or teacher input within horizon.
family_stopping_rule: No further consistency-family experiments in this task regardless of result; v1 remains baseline unless evidence supports a change.
limitations: Single seed, nominal simulation, recorded actions, overlapping windows; fixedlambda.1, K10, moving online Encoder targets.
Own-model native latent geometry is not coordinate-invariant across models; relative residual epsilon raw-coordinate dependent.
Train covariance/PCA are distribution proxies; periodic correction diagnostic only, no causal module-root proof.
Historical gradients are recorded only; verifier recomputes saved-best checkpoint metrics without replaying optimization.

analysis.decision: Qualified case A at the fixed seed0 setting: autonomous composition consistency improves H25/H50 observation prediction, correction sensitivity and own-model distribution proxies while preserving reconstruction and healthy latent variance. Short-horizon observation errors regress slightly; this is not a complete solution or a uniquely isolated root-cause proof.
analysis.control: Initial E/T/D hashes exactly match v1/v2; original architecture74119parameters, datasets, manifests, normalization, seed0, Adam.0003, batch order and K10 observation objective unchanged. No baseline retraining. Only auxiliary objective changes to autonomous consistency; no local term.
analysis.selection: All60epochs completed; best by Validation Lobs only. Best at the upper bound is not evidence of convergence and did not authorize further epochs.
analysis.loss: Lobs=mean k0..10,windows,7dims [D_norm(z_pred)-(o-Trainmean)/Trainstd]^2; Lauto=mean k1..10,windows,64dims [(z_pred-stopgrad(E(real future history)))/fixedinitialTrainlatentstd]^2; Ltotal=Lobs+0.1Lauto.
analysis.target_and_gradient_boundary: Entire reference Encoder pass under no_grad plus explicitdetach; original predicted path remains differentiable through all10T compositions and source prefixE. Reference is absent at inference; direct Decoder consistency gradient0. Perturbing reference changes loss, not prediction.

analysis.gradient_interpretation: No optimizer minibatch has weighted-auto gradient norm exceeding observation norm in any module. Ratios describe norms, not projection/alignment or causal dominance; observation gradient is total minus weighted-auto, subject to FP roundoff.

reconstruction.interpretation: Essentially preserved current representation, not a meaningful claim of superior reconstruction. Per-dimension RMSE/R2 in audit.encoder_reconstruction.

analysis.hypothesis: Supported at this controlled single-seed setting: directly aligning composed latent trajectories is more effective for H25/H50 than the tested local consistency objective. This supports a modifiable composition mechanism, not one uniquely proven module root cause or a need for stochastic dynamics.
analysis.deterministic_formulation: Still worth investigating; improved propagation/reconstruction/healthy variance do not establish a full World Model agent or solve long-horizon accuracy. No reward/control/planning claims.
analysis.consistency_family_decision: Stop adding or tuning consistency objectives as requested. Retain this fixed v3 result as a positive controlled experiment; v2 stays negative, v1 stays the historical observation-only baseline. No automatic next experiment or baseline replacement.
analysis.next_single_recommendation: Only recommend an independently authorized multi-seed replication of the fixed v1-vs-v3 contrast (no new loss forms or lambda/K sweep) to test whether this single-seed effect is robust. Do not execute it.
